title: Fix Admin Authorization Error & Merge Earnings into Live List Tab

requirements.summary: Remove the separate 'Earnings' tab from the main navigation and merge the EarningsChecker view directly into the Live Checker tab
acceptanceCriteria: The standalone 'Earnings' tab is no longer visible in the main navigation.
The EarningsChecker content (username lookup, wallet entry, payout request) is accessible from within the Live Checker tab.
No earnings functionality is lost — all EarningsChecker features remain fully functional after the merge.
The Live Checker tab layout is coherent with the merged earnings section (e.g., as a sub-section or secondary tab within Live Checker).

file_operations.description: Remove the 'Earnings' tab from the main navigation. Update the tab list to only include: User View, Upload, Live Checker, and Admin. Remove the TabPanel for Earnings and its associated imports.

Add the EarningsChecker view as a secondary tab or accordion section within the Live Checker view. Implement a sub-navigation or toggle mechanism (e.g., tabs within the view) to allow users to switch between 'Username Checker' and 'Earnings Lookup'. Import and embed the EarningsChecker component so users can access earnings lookup, wallet entry, and payout request functionality without leaving the Live Checker tab. Ensure the layout is coherent and both features are accessible.
